$comment: Measured from .github/workflows by scripts/check-workflow-hardening.mjs. The workflows themselves are changed only through a reviewed deploy change, so a gap this file records is a gap the guard refuses to let grow, not a gap it forgives.

GitHub returned 403 for an unpublished draft asset under the contents-read integration token. The ephemeral repository token is supplied only to the exact pinned-asset download step, checkout persists no credentials, and the signed-app harness strips token variables. This trusted dedicated-branch/manual job never publishes or changes releases.

missingJobTimeout.reason: the step fetches every pinned action ref from github.com, so a hung fetch runs to the six hour default
it is the aggregate gate every other lane reports into; a hang here holds the CI concurrency group and blocks the production deploy that waits on this workflow
a CodeQL database build on a large Rust tree has no natural ceiling
it only creates the draft release
it writes the release row; a stalled connection would otherwise hold the job for six hours
the failure path must not itself be able to hang

releaseJobGlobalInstall.reason: npm install --global @sentry/cli runs in the job that creates the draft release with a contents: write token
releaseJobGlobalInstall.fix: move the Sentry release registration into its own job with contents: read that needs prepare-release

releaseJobGlobalInstall.reason: npm install --global @sentry/cli runs before the Tauri build in the job that uploads the Linux artifacts with a contents: write token; the renderer sourcemaps it uploads exist only inside this job, so the split needs a sourcemaps artifact and is not mechanical
releaseJobGlobalInstall.fix: upload apps/desktop/dist as its own artifact and run the Sentry upload in a contents: read job that needs build-linux

releaseJobGlobalInstall.reason: npm install --global @sentry/cli runs in the job that publishes the release with a contents: write token
releaseJobGlobalInstall.fix: move the Sentry finalize step into its own job with contents: read that needs publish-release

oidcJobRunsInstallScripts.reason: the test job inherits the workflow-level id-token: write grant although it builds and writes nothing, and runs pnpm install with lifecycle scripts; the workflow is outside the release change that added this rule
oidcJobRunsInstallScripts.fix: permissions: contents: read on the test job, which also retires its three allowedWriteScopes entries
